item.title: Sri Lanka's car-free day sparks debate over women's safety
item.description: NEW DELHI (Thomson Reuters Foundation) - When Colombo’s mayor announced Sri Lanka’s congested capital would go car-free this Sunday to promote a “healthier” lifestyle. But no one appears to have anticipated the furious backlash from women in the city, who say cars offer them much-needed protection from sexual harassment on the streets and on public transport … More…
